integrity: Analytic proofs provided for all sizes and parameters; symbolic rational and numerical tests are supplementary. All reported self-review are reproducible; no independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional quadratic; exact curvature-inverse constant step; independent centered two-point noise; clipping cap equal to total noise span divided by a positive integer. Stationary averaging limit at fixed integer cap ratio. Known general reflected birth-death formulas are not claimed as original; publication priority remains subject to independent scrutiny.
title: A sharp skewness window and a mixing penalty in two-atom clipped SGD
